source: Brothers and sisters, have youseen this? The reason that God renews our heart and gives us a new heart at the time of our regeneration is that He wants us to incline toward Him, adore Him,desire Him,and love Him.Before,we did not love Him and we could not love Him, because our heart was old and hard. Now He has renewed, softened, and turned our heart; thus, we are both able and willing to love Him. Since our heart by being renewed has become a new heart, it now has a new function. This new function is that it can incline toward God and love God and the things of God.

source: Internal Debts: A sum of ₹ 2,429.00 crore is estimated to be received from Internal Debts of the State.Internal Debts include various loans such as Market Loans which is projected at ₹ 900.00 crore, NABARD Loan is kept at ₹ 170.00 crore, National Co-operative Development Corporation Loan capped at ₹ 5.00 crore, Rural Electricity Corporation at ₹ 2.00 crore, Power Financing Corporation loan estimated at ₹ 2.00 crore and SIDBI loan of ₹ 350.00 crore.The Government vows to continue rural infrastructure development works through NABARD loans.Some of the major projects approved for funding under NABARD RIDF XXVII are Construction of CHCs, PHCs etc. & for Infrastructure and Logistic Supplies for Fighting the Ongoing Covid Pandemic with a total project outlay of ₹ 27.25 crore, Upgradation of Existing 17.9 km Road to Cement Concrete Pavement from Meidum - Hortoki (Phase-II) with a project amount of ₹ 133.66 crore, Construction of Separate 11kV Feeders for Power Supply to Agricultural Lands amounting to ₹ 12.25 crore, Soil Conservation Measures for Enhancement of Productivity in Mizoram with a total project cost of ₹ 10.00 crore and Six Irrigation Projects in Mizoram with a project amount of ₹ 10.47 crore. The State is also committed to take up more rural development projects in the coming Financial Year.

source: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...

source: DEO LAWNGTLAI PUBLISHES DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS published a draft electoral roll 2020 of three assembly constituencies within Lawngtlai District tomorow at her office chamber and handed over the draft electoral rolls to representatives of the political parties. As per the draft electoral roll, there are 31372 voters (15852 males and 15520 females) in 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C, 26926 voters (13524 males and 13402 females) in 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C and 24000 voters (11626 males and 12374 females) in 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C. In total, there are 82298 voters (41002 males and 41296 females) in Lawngtlai District. Claims and objections regarding the draft roll can be filed upto 15th January, 2020. The qualifying date for the roll is 1st January, 2020. Final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on 7th February, 2020. Meanwhile, 8 new polling stations in addition to the existing 62 stations in Tuichawng Constituency, 1 new polling station in addition to the existing 68 stations in Lawngtlai West Constituency and 7 new polling stations in addition to the existing 35 stations in Lawngtlai East Constituency are created resulting to the total number of 181 polling stations in Lawngtlai District. Draft roll hi political party ai awhte hnenah a hlan nghal. Draft electoral roll tlangzarh tak atanga a lan danin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520, an vaiin mi 31372 an awm a; 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402, an vaiin mi 26926 an awm a; 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C bialah voter mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374, an vaiin mi 24000 an awm a; assembly bial pathumah hian vote nei mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296, an vaiin mi 82298 an awm a ni. Summary revision neih turah hian sawi duh neite tan kum thar January ni 15 thleng hun hawn a ni a. February ni 7, 2020-ah final electoral roll chu tar chhuah tura tih a ni. Hemi rual hian Tuichawng biala polling station 62 awm saah a thar 8 hawn belh niin, polling station 70 a awm tawh dawn a; Lawngtlai West-a polling station awm sa 68-ah a thar 1 hawn belh niin, polling station 69 a awm tawh ang a; Lawngtlai East-a polling station awm sa 35 baka a thar hawn belh 7 nen polling station 42 awm tawhin, Lawngtlai District chhunga bial pathumah hian a vaiin polling station 181 a awm tawh dawn a ni. DEO LAWNGTLAI-IN 2020 ELECTORAL ROLL DRAFT A TICHHUAK

District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai, Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan nimin khan a office chamber-ah Lawngtlai District chhunga Assembly Constituency pathumte 2020 electoral roll draft a tichhuak a, political party aiawhte hnenah draft electoral roll-te chu a hlan bawk.

Draft electoral roll angin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C-ah voter 31372 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520 an ni. 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C-ah voter 26926 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402 an ni. 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C-ah voter 24000 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374 an ni. A vaiin Lawngtlai District-ah voter 82298 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296 an ni.

Draft roll chungchangah claim leh objection-te chu 15 January, 2020 thleng thehluh theih a ni. Roll-a qualifying date chu 1 January, 2020 a ni. Electoral roll hnuhnung ber chu 7 February, 2020-ah tichhuak tura ruahman a ni.

Hetih lai hian, Tuichawng Constituency-a polling station awmsa 62 bakah polling station thar 8 siam belh a ni a; Lawngtlai West Constituency-a polling station awmsa 68 bakah polling station thar 1 siam belh a ni bawk a; Lawngtlai East Constituency-a polling station awmsa 35 bakah polling station thar 7 siam belh a ni bawk. Chutiang chuan Lawngtlai District-a polling station zawng zawng zat chu 181 a tling ta.

“Happy Childhood” tih thupui hmanga, nimin khan Mamit-a GSA Playground-ah District Child Protection Unit, Mamit District-in naupangte tana Fun Day initiative programme angin Children’s Week chu an hawng a. Dr. R. Lalrinhlua, DCPO Mamit chuan Fun Day hi eng vangin nge buatsaih a nih tih a sawi a, naupangte chu an pianpui nihnaah an lo puitling theih nan nuam leh thil siam theihna lam hawi boruak siam a pawimawhzia a tarlang bawk. Aizawl, 11 May 2022; Hnuai-a tarlan ang hian, Mizoram Sawrkarin State Medical and Technical Entrance Examination (SMATEE) 2022 exam hun a sawn hnuh a ni. He Office Order No.A.45011/2/2021-JDT(HTE), Aizawl, 11 April 2022-a tihchhuah tawh angin, State Medical and Technical Entrance Examination (SMATEE) 2022 atan online application form thehluhna ni hnuhnung leh hun hnuhnung chu 3 June 2022 (Zirtawpni) zan dar 11:59 pm thlengin a sei belh a ni. Chu bakah, SMATEE 2022 exam neih hun pawh 17 June 2022 (Zirtawpni) zing dar 11:00 am atanga chawhnu dar 2:00 pm inkarah sawn hnuh a ni bawk.

source:
Not long after I was released from prison, I became
seriously ill with tuberculosis. I was confined to bed for six
months of absolute rest, followed by two and a half years
of greatly restricted activity for recovery. Outwardly speak-
ing, those days were really dark. But, I tell you, whenever
I prayed I felt that I was not in bed. but in the heavens.
Though I was gravely ill, yet when I prayed I had the sense
that I was not in illness, but far above it all in the heavens.
You do not know what kind of pleasure I had in the Lord
in those days. Imprisonment and persecution, then poverty
and illness. But, praise the Lord, the ascended Christ was
my way! The transcendent Christ was my way to the
heavens.

source: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.
reference: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. A building plinth area hi 574.875 Square metres niin building hi floor nga (5) a sak a ni a. First floor hi Agriculture leh marketing lama training leh awareness centre atan ruahman niin mihring 300 vel leng tura hisap a ni. Ground floor ah hian guest room, conference/meeting room te awmin Basement I ah hian mi 78 lenna market area bakah market office ruamhan niin Basement II ah mi 85 lenna market area niin Basement III hi motor 25 lenna parking area-a ruahman a ni. No.612/2020-2021  
Aizawl, 15th March, 2021 : Mizoram Rajya Sabha MP K. Vanlalvena chuan tun hian Rajya Sabha Chairman leh India Vice President Shri Venkaiah Naidu chu a official inah a hmu a, Myanmar rama buaina nasa tak thleng mekah remna leh muanna siamthat lehna atan Central sorkar inrawlhna a ngen a; tin, sipai junta-in Myanmar sorkar an lakluh hnu-a democracy, mihring dikna leh rorêlna tana dingtute chungah tihduhdahna nasa tak an tih avanga international border rawn kan tlang a Mizoram-ah himna zawngtute Myanmar mihringte tana puihna leh tanpuina ruahmanna siam tur pawh a ngen bawk.

Vice President a hmuha an inkawmnaah chuan Vanlalvena hi MNF party Adviser Rosangzuala’n a tawiawm a. An pahnih hian Myanmar dinhmun chu a tha loh zawng zawngin a zual deuh deuh thei tih an ngaihtuahna an sawi a. Protest-a tel mi tam tak an thi tawh a, tam zawk leh an hliam bawk a; protest-a tel mi tam tak chu dik lo taka man leh tan in an ni bawk.

Dinhmun hlauhawm tak chu ngaihtuahin, Vanlalvena chuan Central sorkar chu Myanmar mite tana ding turin a ngen a, Myanmar lam hawi foreign policy pawh en thar leh a, ram chhunga remna leh inpumkhatna siamthat lehna tur kawng zawng turin a ngen bawk.

No.342/2021-2022
Aizawl
8th October, 2021

Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana (PMVDY) hnuaia Van Dhan Vikas Kendra (VDVK) Level Advocacy Programme chu Mamit District-a Kawrthah khuaa SSA Block Resource Centre-ah, Mamit District Cooperative Officer Pu Lalthangfala hruainain neih a ni.

Kawrthah VDVK Centre hnuaiah Kawrthah cluster-a hmeichhia hnam hrang hrang mi 300-te chu tailoring zirna pek an ni ang.

Mamit District Cooperative Office ruahmanin PMVDY hnuaia VDVK chungchang hriatna programme chu zirlaite tana neih a ni.

source: a) Post Devolution Revenue Deficit Grants: Revenue Deficit Grants are released as monthly installments to 17 States as per the recommendations of the Fifteenth Finance Commission to meet the gap in Revenue Accounts of the States post devolution.States which still show revenue deficit post devolution are recommended Revenue Deficit Grants. The Centre has put an estimated amount of ₹ 1,615.00 crore for 2022-23 as recommended by the Fifteenth Finance Commission which is 9.78% lower than the current year’s BE.The recommended Revenue Deficit Grants diminish towards the end of the Finance Commission award period with only ₹ 586.00 crore recommended for 2025-26.

source: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. Kumin Vigilance Week thupui chu - 'Hlemhletna hnawl la, ram tan thawk rawh' (Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation) a ni. Ram hmundangte rualin vawiin chawhma khan Mizoramah pawh 'Vigilance Week 2023' hawn nan Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma kaihhruaina hnuaiah Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO-a sorkar hnathawk, officials and staff zawng zawngten a huhovin 'Integrity Pledge' thuchham an chham rual a. Sorkar office tina Heads of Office-te pawhin an hnuaia thawk officer leh staff-te nen anmahni office hmun theuhah 'Integrity Pledge' hi an chhamrual bawk a ni. MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY-IN Sawrkar hnathawkte a hruaiin rinawmna thutiam an siam

275/2023-2024

Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 hi tunin, a ni chu 30 October atanga 5 November, 2023 thlengin India ram pumah hman tur a ni. Kumina thupui chu - “Corruption chu ti lo ula, ram tana inpêk rawh u” tih a ni.

Mizoram-ah pawh Vigilance Week hawnna atan, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma-in vawiin zingah Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO-a officer leh staff-te a hruaiin Secretariat Courtyard-ah “Integrity Pledge” an siamtir a ni.

Chutiang bawkin, State Government hnuaia Office hrang hrang hotute pawhin an office hrang hrangah hnathawkte a hruaiin Integrity Pledge an siamtir vek a. He thutiamah hian sawrkar hnathawk tinte chuan nun kawng zawng zawngah dikna leh dan zawmna an zawm ang, ruihhlo an la dawn lo vang a, an pe dawn lo vang, hnathawh zawng zawng rinawm tak leh lang tlang taka an ti ang, mipui thatna atan an chet ang, mi mal nungchangah rinawmna lantirin entawn tlak takin an nung ang, tin, corruption thil thleng apiang chu agency dik tak hnenah an report ang tih an tiam a ni.

source: HEALTH MINISTER DR. R. LALTHANGLIANA FLAGGED OFF 11 MOBILE MEDICAL VAN IN MAMIT DISTRICT No.541/2020-2021 Dr. R. Lalthangliana Health Minister flagged off 11 Bolero Campers designed for Mobile medical van to be used in rural areas of Mamit Aspiration District. Health Minister specially thank REC Ltd for their selfless help through their CSR initiatives in fostering aspiring district like Mamit which would help them aspire i in various development fields. Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 nos were bought for - Rs. 1,04,50,000/- under REC Ltd. CSR initiative as reported by Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro. Also Laptop & Speaker consisting of 52 nunbers worth Rs. 24,60,000/- was also handed over by the minister to CMO and DMS Mamit District hospital. Essential Drugs & Diagnostic kits 76 nos - worth Rs.15,60,000/- and Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol and other Diagnostic Kits of 50 nos and Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit etc were given out in the same programme. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials and NGOs and Village Council leaders were present at the programme. The Flagged off programme was chaired by the DC Mamit himself Dr. Lalrozama IAS. Attachment Loading attachment...
reference: HEALTH MINISTER-IN MAMIT DISTRICT CHHUNGA HMAN TUR MOBILE MEDICAL VAN LEH HMANRAW DANGTE VAILIAM No.7589/2020-2021 Vawiin khan Dr. R. Lalthangliana, Minister, Health & Family Welfare Department, Higher & Technical Education, Commerce & Industries chuan Mobile Medical Van, Essential Drugs & Diagnostic Kits & Laptops and Speaker Mamit District Hospital, PHC/CHC leh Sub- Centre-a hman tur vailiam. Khuallian Dr. R Lalthangliana chuan Mamit District chhunga cheng te'n hriselna kawnga hma an sawn theihna tura hmanraw tangkai tak taka thuam an ni chu a lawmawm thusawiin District - 11 zinga Medical Doctor ngei District Bawrhsap, hriselna kawnga a ngaihna hria in nei chu in vannei takzet a. Aspirational District atangin Mizoram District 11- te zingah pakhatna ni thei tura tan la tura chahin in tum tlat chuan theihloh a awm lo a ni tiin kum zabi 21-a hmasawnna chu hmang tangkaiin dik taka kan hmachhawn chuan District hnufual ber thin kha a ropui ber kan ni thei a ni a ti. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. Rs. 15,60,000/- senga lei damdawi chi hrang hrang 76 - Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits 50 - Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte Sub Centre/Health & Wellness Centre- te hman tur khuallian hian a hlan bawk. He Project hian a tum ber chu Health & welness Centre hi mi tam zawkin health care services an dawn theihna tur leh a tlawhtute mamawh damdawi leh diagnostic kit te a thlawna pek chhuah a ni a, health and welness centre hi mi tam zawkin hmang tangkaia, an tlawh tam (footfall) nana kalpui a ni. Vawiin vek hian Rs. 24,60,000/- senga lei Laptop leh Speaker 52, Mamit District chhung khua tlawh pawh harsa leh health care facility nei thalo khuate tan awlsam zawka health care provider te an biak pawh zung zung theihna turin Telemedicine atan Health Department hnenah hlan a ni bawk. He hun hi Dr. Lalrozama, IAS, Deputy Commissioner chuan kaihruaiin, Pu Beitlotha Nohro, SDC pawhin report pe-in Health Project hnuaiah Aspirational District kan nih avanga hriselna lama hma kan sawn theihna tura thuam kan nih dante a tarlang a. Dr. Vanlalfela, Chief Medical Officer, Mamit-in lawmthu sawina a nei bawk. Minister hi Er. H. Lalzirliana, 3-Mamit Bialtu MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials, Mamit khawpui chhunga Head of Offices bakah khawtlang hruaitute'n leh thutharthehdarhtute'n an tawiawm a ni. raw_text:
MAMIT DISTRICT-A MOBILE MEDICAL VAN 11 TE Health Minister Dr. R. Lalthangliana-IN A THLAK CHHUAK

No.541/2020-2021

Health Minister Dr. R. Lalthangliana chuan Mamit Aspiration District khawpui lo leh thingtlang hmunah hman tur Mobile Medical Van atan siam Bolero Camper 11 a thlak chhuak. Health Minister chuan REC Ltd chu an CSR initiative hmangin Mamit ang district hmasawn duh takte tan an puihna rilru thianghlim avangin lawmthu a sawi a, hei hian hmasawnna kawng hrang hrangah an hma lak theihna a pui dawn tih a sawi bawk.

Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro report angin, Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 hi REC Ltd. CSR initiative hnuaiah Rs. 1,04,50,000/- manin lei a ni. Chu bakah, Laptop leh Speaker 52, a man Rs. 24,60,000/- chu Minister chuan CMO leh DMS, Mamit District Hospital hnenah a hlan bawk.

Essential Drugs leh Diagnostic Kits 76, a man Rs. 15,60,000/- te leh Folic Acid, Oral Rehydration Salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits dang 50, tin, Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte pawh programme vekah sem chhuah a ni bawk.

Programme-ah hian Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department official-te, NGO-te leh Village Council hruaitute an tel a. Flagged off programme hi DC Mamit, Dr. Lalrozama, IAS ngeiin a kaihruai.

God’s Word says, “And Hezekiah was glad for them and showed them his treasury, the silver and the gold, and the spices and the precious oil, and his whole armory and everything which was found among his treasures” (v. 2).
